paths.mechanism: Aflibercept (Pavblu) engages VEGFA to modulate retinal vein occlusion pathology.
Aflibercept (Pavblu) engages PGF to modulate diabetic macular edema pathology.

Aflibercept (Pavblu) engages PGF to modulate retinal vein occlusion pathology.
Aflibercept (Pavblu) engages PGF to modulate corneal neovascularization pathology.
Aflibercept (Pavblu) engages VEGFA to modulate peritoneal neoplasm pathology.
Aflibercept (Pavblu) engages VEGFB to modulate diabetic macular edema pathology.
Aflibercept (Pavblu) engages VEGFA to modulate diabetic macular edema pathology.
Aflibercept (Pavblu) engages VEGFA → Bevacizumab (Mvasi) to modulate clear cell renal carcinoma pathology.
Aflibercept (Pavblu) engages VEGFA → Bevacizumab (Mvasi) to modulate peritoneal neoplasm pathology.
Aflibercept (Pavblu) engages VEGFA → Bevacizumab (Mvasi) to modulate fallopian tube cancer pathology.
Aflibercept (Pavblu) engages VEGFA → Bevacizumab (Mvasi) to modulate papillary renal cell carcinoma pathology.
Aflibercept (Pavblu) engages VEGFA → Bevacizumab (Mvasi) to modulate collecting duct carcinoma pathology.
Aflibercept (Pavblu) engages VEGFA → Bevacizumab (Mvasi) to modulate ovarian carcinoma pathology.
Aflibercept (Pavblu) engages VEGFA → RANIBIZUMAB to modulate pathological myopia pathology.
Aflibercept (Pavblu) engages VEGFA → Ranibizumab to modulate retinopathy of prematurity pathology.
